@@U02333@@
(Singing in turns and accompanied by guitars and bass lutes, the FLOWER GIRLS and GARDENERS continue to lay out their wares in tiers that gradually mount upward and offer them for sale.)

@@U02334@@
(Enter MOTHER and DAUGHTER.)

@@U02336@@
Dear girl, dear child, when you were born what a darling face you had, and so dainty of figure! I dressed you in a lovely bonnet, seeing you wed to the wealthiest of men, a bride already, his wife, a lady. But how many years have passed since then, unused, and nothing. Beaux have come and beaux have gone, beaux of all kinds, fled on by. Oh, yes, you danced sprightly with one, and with another you gave him a nudge, a subtle hint. Parties we planned all went wrong; Forfeit games and Odd-Man-Out, all, all a waste. But tonight be wise, love, bait your hook, spread your legs, fools are out in force, my dear! Catch one. (Other beautiful young GIRLS join the others and intimate chatter ensues. FISHERMEN and BIRDCATCHERS with nets, fishing poles, limed sticks, and other gear, enter and fraternize with the GIRLS. Mutual attempts to attract, catch, evade, and hold fast lead to opportunities for pleasant banter. Q

@@U02338@@
(Enter boisterous and boorish.)

@@U02339@@
Room! Make room!
translation:
@@U02333@@
（在吉他和低音鲁特琴的伴奏下，花童和园丁轮流唱歌，继续将他们的商品按层排列，逐渐向上排列并出售。）

@@U02334@@
（母亲和女儿上。）

@@U02336@@
亲爱的姑娘，亲爱的孩子，当你出生时，你有一张多么可爱的脸庞，多么优美的身材啊！我给你戴上一顶可爱的帽子，看着你嫁给了最富有的男人，已经是新娘了，他的妻子，一位女士。但多少年过去了，无人使用，一无所获。花花公子来了，花花公子走了，各种各样的花花公子，纷纷离去。哦，是的，你和一个人一起欢快地跳舞，而和另一个人一起，你轻轻地推了他一下，一个微妙的暗示。我们计划的聚会全都失败了；放弃比赛和奇人出局，一切，一切都是浪费。但今晚要明智，亲爱的，上钩，张开双腿，傻瓜们大举出动，亲爱的！抓住一个。 （其他美丽的年轻女孩也加入其中，亲密的聊天随之而来。渔民和捕鸟者带着网、钓鱼竿、石灰棍和其他装备，进入并与女孩们交朋友。相互尝试吸引、捕捉、躲避和牢牢抓住，从而有机会进行愉快的玩笑。Q

@@U02338@@
（喧闹而粗鲁地进入。）

@@U02339@@
房间！腾出空间！
